'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**The [[Bank of Japan|central bank of Japan]] raises its [[inflation]] forecast and reduces [[fiscal year]] expectations while maintaining ultra-low interest rates, saying that the economy was primarily impacted by the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/21/bank-of-japan-raises-inflation-forecast-keeps-policy-steady.html (CNBC)]
**The [[European Central Bank]] raises [[interest rate]]s by 0.5 percentage points for the first time since 2011 in order to combat inflation in the [[EU]] which increased to 8.6% last month. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/jul/21/european-central-bank-raises-interest-rates-for-first-time-in-11-years (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pakistan floods]]
**At least 304 people are killed after five weeks of [[monsoon]] rains and [[flash flood]]s in [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-pakistan-traffic-monsoons-3139560ab3dc50f0b52db930f56ae839 (AP)]
*[[Taiwan]] reports a record temperature of {{cvt|40.7|C|F}} in [[Yuli, Hualien|Yuli]]. However, this measurement is not officially recognized by Taiwanese authorities because it was reported by an [[Automatic weather station|automated station]]. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4602212 (''Taiwan News'')] [https://www.cna.com.tw/news/ahel/202207210302.aspx (CNA Taiwan)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/biden-tests-positive-covid-white-house-says-rcna39334 (NBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[Tokyo]] reports a record 31,878 new [[COVID-19]] cases in the past 24 hours. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/Tokyo-COVID-cases-top-30-000-for-1st-time-shatter-previous-record (''Nikkei Asia'')]
*[[Holocene extinction]]
**[[Conservation-reliant species]]
***[[An An (giant panda)|An An]], the world's longest-living male [[giant panda]] under human care, dies at [[Ocean Park Hong Kong]] aged 35. An An was a key part of the conservation activities for giant pandas. [https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1658683-20220721.htm (RTHK)]
**The [[monarch butterfly]] is added by the [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]] to its endangered species list because of rapidly decreasing population numbers. [https://apnews.com/article/science-north-america-insects-butterflies-climate-and-environment-c5e406e2f01c731167393296c19c302b (AP)]
*The [[United States]] reports its first case of [[polio]] since 2013 in an unvaccinated person from [[Rockland County, New York|Rockland County]], [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna39390 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 New York gubernatorial election]]
**A man attempts to stab [[Lee Zeldin]], a [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] and the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] nominee in the upcoming [[Governor of New York|New York gubernatorial]] election, during a campaign event in [[Perinton, New York]], United States. Zeldin is not hurt during the incident, and the man is taken into custody. [https://www.wivb.com/news/witnesses-gov-candidate-lee-zeldin-attacked-at-perinton-campaign-stop/ (WIVB-TV)]
*A police officer, a civilian, and 16 suspected gang members are killed during an operation against [[organized crime]] in a [[favela]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/america-latina/2022/07/21/al-menos-18-muertos-en-una-operacion-policial-en-una-favela-de-rio-de-janeiro/?outputType=amp-type (Infobae)]
*The [[Ministry of Justice (Russia)|Ministry of Justice of Russia]] opens a court case to close the [[Jewish Agency for Israel]], the main agency allowing the [[aliyah]] of Jews to [[Israel]]. Israel condemns the court case, claiming it is a response to Israel's stance on the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62254595 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Italian government crisis]]
**[[Mario Draghi]] resigns as [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] of [[Italy]]. [[President of Italy|President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] accepts Draghi's resignation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62249050 (BBC News)]
**Mattarella dissolves the [[Parliament of Italy]], calling for a [[2022 Italian general election|snap parliamentary election]]. [https://www.lastampa.it/politica/2022/07/21/news/draghi_alle_9_alla_camera_subito_dopo_salira_al_quirinale_per_dimettersi_si_va_verso_il_voto_in_ottobre_conte_e_salvini_h-5469353/?ref=LSHRU-BH-I0-PM5-S1-T1 (''la Stampa'')]
*[[2022 Sri Lankan presidential election]]
**[[Ranil Wickremesinghe]] is sworn in as [[President of Sri Lanka|president]] of [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-colombo-ranil-wickremesinghe-government-and-politics-d84674d3a3c54e70b56a0a1a76a45e97 (AP)]
*[[2022 Indian presidential election]]
**[[Droupadi Murmu]] is elected as the new [[President of India|president]] of [[India]], making her the first female from a [[Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes|scheduled tribe]] to be elected to the post. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/droupadi-murmu-is-indias-new-president-3181043#pfrom=home-ndtv_topscroll (NDTV)]
*[[2022 Brazilian general election]]
**Former [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva|Lula da Silva]] is nominated by the [[Workers' Party (Brazil)|Workers' Party]] to run in the upcoming presidential election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/21/da-silva-confirmed-as-brazil-partys-presidential-candidate (Al Jazeera)]
